verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax documents recording external transactions [stripe-tax-docs-1], economic-nexus monitoring [stripe-tax-docs-17] and zero-tax results with a taxability_reason [stripe-tax-docs-13]. However, nothing in the pack covers marketplace-facilitator sales: no way to flag tax as collected by Amazon or the app stores, count those sales toward nexus, or exclude them from remittance. The axis applies to a sales-tax product, so this absence of evidence means none.
